scope.summary: Implement a text-only editing surface (story editor) presenting a StudioTextStory as linear text with a style column, depth indicator, overset marker, and inline display of notes, tracked changes, tables, and structure tags, editing the SAME story authority as the layout view. Placed-text import MUST honor saved option sets: word-processor/RTF import maps incoming styles (MT-171) or preserves them and carries footnotes, endnotes, and tables; plain-text import controls encoding, target dictionary, and carriage-return cleanup; spreadsheet import selects sheet, range, and formatting mode (MT-166/MT-167 tables). Concrete import formats owned by 14.13.
acceptance_criteria: story editor over shared story authority with full inline display; import honors saved option sets across WP/RTF/plain/spreadsheet
proof_targets: story-editor shared-authority runtime; import option-set test
expected_tests: live: story editor edits the same StudioTextStory authority as layout view; shows style column/overset/notes/tables/tags
test: WP/RTF import maps-or-preserves styles + carries footnotes/endnotes/tables; plain-text encoding/dictionary/CR cleanup

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Story editor & importing text

risk_if_missed: No linear text editing; importing external copy loses styles/notes/tables.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
